title: FAA UAP reports, batch 07 (237UAP00158 - 237UAP00182)
doc_notes: This document is a batch of FAA Skywatch incident reports regarding UAP sightings, containing one report of an anomalous maneuver by a balloon.

encounters.summary: Pilot reported observing a large balloon that appeared to drop 20,000 feet in altitude.
encounters.quote: PIC reported they observed the balloon take a 20,000 foot drop in altitude.
